title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff and regional failover under thrashing
author: Priya Rao
description: Context: Recent incident (SUP-9821) exposed a thrashing interaction between the SLO enforcer backoff timers and regional circuit-breaker failover logic. Under sustained load spikes + transient region latency, the enforcer aggressively backoffed then immediately retried, causing rapid failover oscillation and elevated error budgets. Motivation: prevent oscillation and provide graceful degradation without user-visible error spikes. Summary of changes: 1) SLO enforcer backoff now uses capped exponential backoff with randomized jitter and a minimum cooldown window per region to prevent immediate retries; 2) regional failover now records a short cooldown window where traffic is only partially shifted (stepwise failover) instead of full cut-over; 3) added hysteresis on circuit-breaker reclose conditions to require sustained healthy metrics for N seconds; 4) metrics + traces for enforcer decisions and a dedicated alert for repeated failover oscillation; 5) added e2e regression tests that simulate thrashing workload and verify no more than one failover per 2m. Rollout plan: cut a hotfix to main and squash-merge, rollout as a canary to 10% traffic in us-east-1 for 15 minutes, if stable increase to 50% then global. Rollback: revert deploy (automated via release job) or disable SLO-enforcer feature flag. Testing: unit tests for backoff math, integration tests against mock regional endpoints, e2e against perf-canary harness; CI flaky integration re-run validated. Impact: reduces failover oscillation, may slightly increase tail latency during cooldown windows (expected trade-off).

review_comments: Miguel Santos: LGTM overall — requested clarification on cooldown default and operator override. Response: cooldown set to 30s by default, configurable via env + feature flag (added to docs).

Ethan Moore: flagged potential perf regression for long-tail latency. Response: added canary rollout and perf tests; telemetry shows 3-5% tail increase under simulated cooldown but overall fewer error spikes.
Zoe Kim: asked to add alert when oscillation counter > 3 in 10 minutes. Response: alert added (ops-alert:failover-oscillation) and integrated into console dashboard.
QA: ran e2e thrashing test in staging — initial integration flaky, re-ran with mock stability and validated no oscillation for 30m.
release_notes: Hotfix: Stabilize SLO enforcer and regional failover to prevent rapid failover oscillation under thrashing workloads. Adds capped backoff with jitter, per-region cooldown, hysteresis for circuit breakers, and an alert for oscillation detection. Rollout as canary with ability to rollback via feature flag.
